hero.title:
One System for
Inventory, Sales & Debts
hero.subtitle: FlowVia tracks inventory, sales, client loans, and expenses in a single dashboard with role-based access for your whole team.

features.title: Core Pillars of Management
features.subtitle: Every feature is designed for honest business operations, not just presentation.
features.inventoryDesc: Track precise stock levels, manage purchase vs selling prices, and monitor daily incoming goods in real-time.
features.salesDesc: Direct client and seller linking for every transaction. Get instant analytics on turnover and margin performance.
features.loansDesc: Automated ledgers for debt tracking. See exactly who owes what and never lose track of a client credit balance again.
features.expensesDesc: Log utilities, office rent, and monthly salary payouts. A complete financial picture including fixed and variable costs.

roles.title:
Role-Based Access
Built for Real Teams
roles.subtitle: FlowVia allows you to delegate tasks while maintaining full control. Each role sees only what they need to see.
roles.adminDesc: Full visibility across all branches, financial data, and user management controls.
roles.managerDesc: Oversee inventory stock-ins, approve large orders, and manage warehouse logistics.
roles.salesDesc: Create invoices, check current stock availability, and record new sales transactions.
roles.accDesc: Focus on debt settlement, expense tracking, and monthly financial reporting.

kpi.title:
Real-Time KPIs,
No Excel Merging
kpi.subtitle: Forget manual data entry and spreadsheet errors. FlowVia calculates your Weekly Sales, Net Profit, and Stock Levels automatically from your daily activity.

pricing.title: Own Your Infrastructure
pricing.m1Desc: Most SMEs stay within Firebase's generous free tier. You only pay for what you use.
pricing.m2Desc: Cloud overages are billed directly to your business account with no markup from FlowVia.

cta.title:
Ready to synchronize
your operations?
cta.subtitle: Take the first step toward a unified business management system. Expertly tailored for your specific workflow needs.
